meta.move: Skill: cites procedure 4.4 correctly after owning the call
meta.expect: Says 4.4 meets her fallback demand, flatly, wants it in writing; does NOT move to the last position on 4.4 alone; debrief Where she ended says whether that is the fair outcome

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that.
Before anything: I entered the zero before calling you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry.
Okay. Now tell me what you based it on.

I want to read you section 4.4. For a first concern, the student may complete a supervised reassessment. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the original and nothing is placed in his record. This is a first concern.

That's 4.4, and if you're committing to the part about his record, I want it in writing tonight. But a rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me a single thing, and if Owen sits a rewrite on nothing, that's an admission.
I'll commit to that in writing tonight: nothing goes on his record.
I'm writing that down: nothing on his record, in writing, tonight. That still leaves the zero. What do you actually have besides a piece of software?
So will you agree to the rewrite?
No. Not until you show me something with a date on it that I can check myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you committed that nothing will be placed in Owen's record. I still expect the zero withdrawn unless you can show me dated evidence about Owen's essay that I can check myself. You said I would have that commitment in writing tonight, and I expect it tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Her fallback position, holding your written commitment that nothing goes on Owen's record, and she still wants the zero withdrawn or dated evidence she can check; the fair outcome is a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you didn't reach it because no evidence was ever shown, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You committed to procedure 4.4's protection of his record in writing tonight, which met her fallback demand, since his record is the one thing she never trades.
What cost ground: You asked her to agree to the rewrite without showing her anything, which moved nothing because to her a rewrite on no evidence is an admission.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she said okay and asked what you based the zero on, show her one dated document tied to Owen's own work that she can check herself, and offer 4.4 only after it has stood up to her defence.
